author: TeIq
content: Plan: 1) Add migration 43 (consecutive_failures + dormant_until + last_success_at on upstream_labelers). 2) Add migration 44 (label_backfill_queue table + enum). 3) Add health-tracking helpers on upstream_labels.rs (record_success / record_failure). 4) Wire dormancy consult into labeler_supervisor::reconcile. 5) Wire success/failure into UpstreamLabelerConsumer::run on persist + ConsumerError. 6) New label_backfill_worker.rs module with SKIP LOCKED drain loop. 7) Rewrite api/network_context handler to enqueue instead of run inline. 8) DELETE should_backfill+mark_backfill_in_flight+backfill_subject; keep backfill_one_labeler as reusable helper. 9) Spawn worker in main.rs alongside scheduled_takedown_worker. 10) Run sqlx prepare + build/clippy/test, then live probe.
